messages:
alex chan: Heads up — I'm prototyping a 'gatehouse' sampling mode for request/response telemetry. Goal: let SRE/SEs opt into small, auditable samples with gated PII unmasking for debug windows. sketch below.

priya rao: love the name 😄 what's the gate criteria? per-route? per-tenant?

alex chan: per-route default, overridden by tenant allowlist or canary flags. will use a stable sample key so we can correlate flows without full payloads.

sam kim: curious about PII handling — are we hashing everything or redacting client-provided tokens?

alex chan: plan: layered approach — quick heuristics to scrub obvious PII (emails, ips), then HMAC tokenization for identifiers we need to debug linkage. HMAC key rotates and only infra can unmask during a time-limited inspect session.

jordan lee: ops question: how do we surface inspect sessions in the console? we don't want a buried toggle that ops misses during incidents.

alex chan: proposal: Console -> Route detail -> "Inspect samples" card. Toggle to request samples (0.1% default). When you request a preview, a modal shows 5 live samples with redaction state and a button to request temporary unmask (audit log + approval).

priya rao: can we make the preview fast-fail if the route has sensitive tag? e.g., routes labeled `sensitive=true` must go through JIT approval.

alex chan: yes. We'll surface tags from infra config. Sensitive routes require a 2-step approval (owner + security) before unmask. Preview still shows redacted samples though.

sam kim: does sampling happen at edge or collector? hit rate matters. doing it at edge keeps fidelity but adds latency.

alex chan: plan is hybrid: edge does lightweight fingerprinting + deterministic sampling decision, then full payload is forwarded to internal sampling queue only for chosen traces. reduces volume while keeping low latency.

ingrid-bot: note: we currently have a 500MB/day quota on the telemetry ingest for the dev cluster. any new flow should include quota-aware backpressure.

alex chan: good catch — we'll add quota tokens and a token-bucket per-tenant+route. If queue is full, we fall back to metadata-only sampling.

jordan lee: how about retention? For debug windows we might need 7d retention for unmasked sessions but redacted samples can be shorter.

priya rao: agree. propose defaults: redacted samples 30d, unmasked inspect 7d, audit logs 90d. policy configurable per-tenant.

sam kim: small nit: need to document what 'redacted' means. e.g., we replace emails with `<email:redacted>` vs hash. engineers will expect consistent formats for regexes.

alex chan: yes — we'll publish scrub grammar and masked token formats in the docs. basic example: ```
sampling_gate:
  default_rate: 0.001
  per_route_overrides:
    /payments/create: 0.0001
  scrub_rules: [email, ip, credit_card]
  tokenization: HMAC-sha256
  unmask_ttl_seconds: 604800
```

priya rao: UX question: who can flip the unmask? Owners + security + a temporary SRE on-call override? And all flips must create an audit entry with justification.

alex chan: exactly. We'll add a canary "breakglass" flow that requires a reason and auto-notifies security slack channel via ops-bot. ops-bot will also log the ephemeral key id.

ops-bot: automated message: when a breakglass unmask is requested, ops-bot will post a thread in #incidents with reason + requester + link.

jordan lee: rollout plan? feature flag first, then dark launch for 2 small teams, then wider opt-in.

alex chan: yep. Feature flag + telemetry for "sampled_count", "unmask_requests", "dropped_quota". We'll iterate UI after small-team feedback.

priya rao: one blocker: compliance needs to review HMAC unmask policy and retention windows. I'll loop them in.

sam kim: also add a CLI to fetch preview samples for automation: `rwctl samples preview --route /foo --count 5` so engs can script it.

alex chan: added to the plan. Thanks all — I'll open the RFC doc and a canary ticket. tagging @jordan for console mockups and @priya for compliance follow-up.

jordan lee: thumbs up. I'll sketch the modal and share tomorrow.

priya rao: I'll ping legal/compliance.

alex chan: end of thread — RFC link will land here shortly.
